comment: Committed expectation for scripts/dev/parity_v08.sh. differs_* list the record ids that are KNOWN to differ (documented gaps, docs/V08_PARITY_SLICE.md); any other difference is a regression. Labels: SUPPORTED / PARTIAL / UNSUPPORTED / UNVERIFIED, each with a one-line evidence pointer.

resource.comment: gated: peak-RSS growth between rep ceil(N/2) and rep N. At N=500 this flags a per-rep leak of >= ~16 KB; the planted C context leak (PARITY_V08_PERTURB=leak) measured 18304 KB. Rep-1-to-midpoint growth is runtime warm-up (Go GC pacing: ~5.7 MB) and is reported only; Go second-half jitter observed 116 and 512 KB.

c: e01-e09/x01-x04 are the reference; poll_event_kind separates e09.2 (U+1001 CHAR) from e09.3 (ENTER), kind-less poll_event conflates x03/x04
cpp: byte-identical, but gibson.hpp has no headless Context, push_event*, or poll_event_kind: the consumer calls the C ABI directly
py: byte-identical, but gibson.py has no event struct, poll or push (wrapper obs ctx_has_poll_event=0): raw ctypes
go: byte-identical via the consumer's own cgo; bindings/go exposes no headless context, push or poll
rust: e01-e09 byte-identical via InjectedQueue + Context::poll_from; x01/x03/x04 UNSUPPORTED (Rust has no kind-less key path)

c: s15 40x12, r02 60x16: a polled RESIZE resizes the headless context (the only resize path; no direct resize call)
cpp: s15/r02 byte-identical; gibson.hpp has no frame_size: raw C
py: s15/r02 byte-identical via Context.frame_size; the resize itself needs raw ctypes push/poll
go: byte-identical via own cgo; bindings/go has no geometry readback
rust: r02 matches only with an explicit ctx.session.set_terminal_size after poll_from; witness: poll_from alone leaves r02 at 40x12

c: s16/r03 digests over gibson_get_frame_cells + rendered output; s18 RGB+bold+underline, s19 ANSI256+named+italic
cpp: scene built with gibson::Node RAII, but frame_cells/rendered_output only via raw C
py: every CELL record via the wrapper (Context.headless, Node.text+GibsonStyle, frame_cells, frame_cell, rendered_output)
go: byte-identical via own cgo; bindings/go has no styled text node and no readback
rust: s16/r03 digests and s18/s19/s25/r04 byte-identical via Context::frame_cell + rendered_bytes

c: s20/s21 CJK + continuation, s22 combining, s23/s26 25-byte ZWJ via get_frame_cell_glyph, s24/r05 U+1001; s27 inline cap 14 bytes, trunc=1
cpp: gibson::Node::text carries the UTF-8; glyph readback only via raw C
py: via the wrapper: Node.text(str), frame_cell_glyph, GibsonCell.glyph_truncated
go: byte-identical via own cgo; bindings/go has no readback
rust: s17-s26/r05 byte-identical; s27/s28 (C's 16-byte inline glyph cap) UNSUPPORTED: Rust always has the full grapheme

c: p01-p22: 21 INVALID_PARAM + 1 QUEUE_FULL; last-error text recorded for 6 probes
cpp: p01-p22 byte-identical via raw C; gibson.hpp drops statuses (Node::text(invalid UTF-8) -> raw()==nullptr, wrapper obs)
py: p01-p22 byte-identical via raw ctypes; wrapper cannot pass NULL or invalid UTF-8, Node.* ignore the status
go: p01-p22 byte-identical via own cgo with LockOSThread (last error is per thread); bindings/go discards most statuses
rust: no status codes: 13 probes unrepresentable, 7 rejected natively (RUST_NONE/RUST_ERR), 2 ACCEPTED where C rejects (p02, p15)

c: s01 create, l01 free unattached node, l02 destroy(NULL) (null-checked in source, not promised by gibson.h), d01 destroy; no double-destroy (UB)
cpp: l01 freed by gibson::Node RAII; no headless gibson::Context, so create/destroy are raw C
py: create/close/Node.__del__ via the wrapper; l02 destroy(NULL) only via raw ctypes; close() twice is a wrapper no-op
go: byte-identical via own cgo; bindings/go Close() cannot reach a headless context
rust: create/drop byte-identical; l02 UNSUPPORTED (no null Context); ownership by move
